original_value: A fictional compact desktop ambience lamp designed for creative workspaces, featuring adjustable warm-to-cool LED tones, touch controls, a flexible neck, and a weighted base for stable placement on desks and shelves. Built for reading, crafting, and mood lighting rather than computing or storage applications.
